ada.name: Ada Pruitt
ada.description: A broad-shouldered woman with hay in her hair and worry in her face.
initial: Ada Pruitt, who owns the livery, is pacing beside the empty stall.

initial.text: She stops when she sees who you've brought.

ada.noTopic: Ada waves the question away. "Ask me later. Find my mare."

topics.text: "Dun mare, black stockings. Something spooked her and she went off south, down into the wash. She'll come to sugar, if you can get close."
"The sheriff keeps a jar of it on his desk. Sweet tooth on him like a child."
"Take the rope off the peg. Just bring it back."

sheriff.name: sheriff
sheriff.description: A heavy man asleep in his chair, hat tipped over his eyes and boots up on the desk.
sheriff.initial: The sheriff is asleep in his chair with his boots on the desk.
sheriff.noTopic: The sheriff mumbles something about taxes and goes on sleeping.

mare.name: mare
description: A dun mare with black stockings and a white star.

description.text: Your rope is round her neck.
description.else: She watches you with one eye, ready to bolt if you crowd her.

initial.text: The mare stands at the end of your rope.
initial.else: A dun mare stands in the middle of the wash, flanks twitching.
